releaseNotes: New protection foundations in this release. Permanent app restrictions (Phase 3) let an administrator block an exact Android package name with a real PIN; only verified Device Owner native hide or suspension counts as active, restrictions survive reboot and updates, and WhatsApp, YouTube, Zyro and critical system packages are always exempt. Explicit-content DNS protection adds opt-in Cloudflare Families and CleanBrowsing Family DNS-over-TLS presets with PIN-gated activation, readable Android Private DNS state, release and repair paths, plus a content-rules register for local explicit-domain block/allow requests and SafeSearch/YouTube Restricted Mode guidance, with clear on-screen limits where Android cannot enforce custom rules or inspect browser DoH, VPN DNS and in-app content. YouTube Shorts controls (best effort, Accessibility-based) navigate away from recognized Shorts screens. This release also fixes the special Play Store hide/unhide writer so it is no longer refused by the app blocklist, and makes Device Owner release sweep a stale special-control journal so owner removal cannot be blocked by an abandoned transaction.
